question: As of March 2021, which state of India formulated a new education scheme that will facilitate the upgradation and modernisation of the education sector in the state comprehensively, at a total cost of ₹4,000 crores?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Telangana State state of India formulated a new education scheme that will facilitate the upgradation and modernisation of the education sector in the state comprehensively, at a total cost of ₹4,000 crores.
 
• The government has always focused on providing quality education to children from poorer sections.
 
• **Telangana **has formulated a new education scheme that will facilitate the upgradation and modernization of the education sector in the State **comprehensively at a total cost of Rs 4,000 crore.**
 
• The government has set aside Rs 2,000 crore in the 2021-22 budget for the new education scheme.
 
• Under the scheme, the government, in the next two years, will provide basic facilities in all government schools on a large scale.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NEP will be replacing the 10+2 curriculum structure with a 5+3+3+4 structure**. 
 
• The new system has proposed 12 years of school education with 3 years of pre-schooling.
 
• ​ Anganwadi.** 3-6 years of age is globally recognized **as the crucial age for the mental development of the child.
 
• The Cabinet Committee of the Central Government recently approved the** “New Education Policy 2021-2022-2023.**
